long_biography.plain_text:
Based in Western Australia, Mark Taddei has built a career around commercial and industrial property. The Deseree & Mark Family Trust operates the Taddei Group of Companies names, while Desmar Holdings has developed and sold large warehouse and business-park assets. Taddei is also described as a builder, linking development ownership with hands-on construction experience.

That model has also shaped his philanthropy. Desmar coordinated a commercial complex whose development brought together suppliers, tradespeople and a government land agency, generating a seven-figure contribution to Variety WA. Taddei and his wife, Deseree, have continued to appear among major supporters of Western Australian children's charities.

uncertainties.detail: No single reviewed public source names Mark Taddei as the beneficial owner of the exact 35.2-metre Sunseeker. Resolution rests on the source record plus an unusually specific public chain: the same exact Australian name in a A$15 million yachtbroking dispute, the same broker as a respondent, the Western Australia-based Fratelli sale shortly before the filing, and the hull's Fratelli-Pops-Sunset name history. This clears the threshold but is not conclusive title evidence.

The source export describes Sunset as current from 2018, although public records show the hull was delivered in 2019, sold as Fratelli in 2022, renamed Pops and sold again as Sunset in 2025. The saved association is treated as historical identity context, not as a claim of current ownership.

Variety WA directly joins exact-name Mark Taddei to Desmar Holdings, while the Australian Business Register joins Deseree and Mark to Taddei Group of Companies. The Western Australian builder profile and industrial-property transactions reinforce that candidate. The public record does not supply a middle name or birth date for another exact field match.

Searches also surfaced the American-born New Zealand conductor generally styled Marc Taddei, a United States corporate agent named Mark S. Taddei and other unrelated records. Their geography, spelling, professions and institutions conflict with the Australian source and property-yachting evidence, so none of their facts or accounts is merged here.

Exact-name birth, death and obituary searches found no strong, independently matched evidence for a middle name, birth date or place of birth. Australian nationality, residence, male gender, birth country and Alive status remain preserved source values rather than newly proposed conclusions.

The named family trust and Taddei business platform connect him personally to property assets he actively helped develop, construct, underwrite and sell. Under the amended reasonable-inference policy, that positive built-asset mechanism supports broad Self-made at medium confidence. Self-made — independent start and Self-made — advantaged start remain unsupported because first capital and family background are unknown; inherited, family transfer and mixed are rejected because no material transfer mechanism is evidenced.

Desmar's documented property sales confirm real estate as the durable platform but not the current value, ownership percentage or complete portfolio. Transaction prices and changing property totals are excluded from the biography.

LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube and TikTok were checked with exact-name, Perth, Desmar and Taddei Group anchors. Additional supported-type checks covered Company Website, Wikipedia, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow. No personal account or first-party company site had an official cross-link or two strong independent confirmations, so no social is proposed.
Forbes-first exact-name and company searches found no dedicated profile. The absence is reported only as a search result and is not used to infer wealth magnitude.

Property developer is the minimum useful active tag supported across the documented platform. Philanthropy is an enduring biographical dimension, but no separate approved tag was needed; builder and industrial-property activity remain captured in prose and wealth classification.
